declarative.why: kind custom mounts the app's own region by name

notLower.why: what a hand-written page draws is app code the platform cannot generate; the platform provides only the registry, the script load and the narrow api

twice.note: ONE APP ONLY: dsl-conformance-max `warehouse-hint` (web/regions/warehouse-hint.js), added 2026-11-18. The keyword had a validator and no renderer until custom.js was written the same day.

enforced.note: probe 19 proves the region file is served (/regions/warehouse-hint.js) and the experience now has 4 screens; ExperienceValidationTest requires component on custom and refuses it elsewhere; experience-client.test.mjs mounts a region with the frozen api and rejects a component that never registers. The mount in a REAL browser has NOT been driven.

taught.bundleLine: Your own page (`kind:"custom"`): `"component":"<name>"` mounts `web/regions/<name>.js`, which calls `window.npdev.regions.register("<name>",{mount(el,api)})`; the api is `{screen,user,get(url),refresh()}`.
